name: hcapp_syncKennelAdminData
description: Incremental pull-sync for kennel-level admin data (ValidateAppAuth, spNumber 72). Each of the five entity types is gated by a watermark parameter — 'ignore' (default), NULL or a date <= 2000-01-01 skips that table. HasherKennelMap is scoped to @kennelId; Payments and HasherEventMap are scoped to @targetHasherId (a NULL @targetHasherId returns no rows for either). Kennels and Hashers are global. Permission gate on a DIRECT call (@procName NULL): HC6.CheckAreaEntry areaKey 'kennelTools' on the app surface (derived entry — any one kennel-tools capability), else errorCode 1372. Delegated calls from write SPs (@procName set) skip the gate because the write SP already authorised the caller, and validate the token with the delegating SP's name and @param suffix. @includeUnboundPayments (default 0) hides event-less payments from pre-3.1 clients that cannot parse them. Read SP: no success envelope; body is wrapped in TRY/CATCH that logs to HC.ErrorLog and re-throws.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token. Validated against the delegating context (@param) or DeviceSecret by ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel to scope the sync to. Required — returns errorCode 1272 if NULL or zero UUID.

parameters.name: hashersUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Hasher (global, not kennel-scoped). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Hashers rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: kennelsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Kennel (global). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Kennels rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.HasherKennelMap scoped to @kennelId. 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the HasherKennelMap rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.HasherEventMap scoped to @targetHasherId. 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the HasherEventMap rowset.

parameters.name: paymentsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Payment scoped to @targetHasherId. 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Payments rowset.

parameters.name: targetHasherId
parameters.description: Scopes the Payments and HasherEventMap rowsets to this hasher (UserId = @targetHasherId, no kennelId constraint on Payments). When NULL those two rowsets come back empty, since the equality never matches.

parameters.name: usePaging
parameters.description: Default 0 (unlimited). When 1, limits Kennels and HasherKennelMap to 250 rows and Hashers to 2500 rows. Payments and HasherEventMap have no page limit even when paging is enabled.

parameters.name: includeUnboundPayments
parameters.description: Default 0. 0 = omit payments with a NULL EventId or HasherEventMapId (run packages, hare rewards) because pre-3.1 clients declare eventId/hemId as required and fail to parse them; 1 = return every payment (3.1+ clients send 1).

parameters.name: procName
parameters.description: Delegating SP name for write-SP delegation pattern. NULL = direct call. Used as the effective proc name in ValidateAppAuth and error logs.

parameters.name: param
parameters.description: Delegating SP token suffix for write-SP delegation pattern. NULL = DeviceSecret only.

rowsets.name: Error
rowsets.description: Returned instead of all data rowsets on: auth failure from ValidateAppAuth (errorType 11); NULL or zero-UUID @kennelId (errorType 12, errorCode 1272, logged); caller lacking the 'kennelTools' area entry on a direct call (errorType 13, errorCode 1372, logged). Column order is errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification. 11 = auth (ValidateAppAuth); 12 = validation (missing kennelId); 13 = not authorised (kennelTools gate).

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Specific error code. 1272 = null or zero-UUID kennelId; 1372 = not authorised for kennel admin sync; see ValidateAppAuth for auth codes.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: Effective SP name (delegating SP name if called via delegation, otherwise OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)).

rowsets.name: Kennels
rowsets.description: Emitted when @kennelsUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. All kennels updated after the watermark (global, not scoped to @kennelId). Ordered by updatedAt ASC, id ASC. Page limit: 250 rows when @usePaging=1.

rowsets.name: Hashers

rowsets.name: Payments
rowsets.description: Emitted when @paymentsUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. Payments where UserId = @targetHasherId and updatedAt > watermark, across ALL kennels (no @kennelId filter). sideEffects: Inserts an HC.ErrorLog row on the 1272 (missing kennel) and 1372 (not authorised) paths and on any unhandled error (CATCH, then re-throw). Otherwise read-only.

codeSmells.detail: Lines 3-5: @deviceId, @accessToken and @kennelId have no SQL default. A client that omits @kennelId is refused by SQL ('expects parameter') before the body runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row — and the SP's own 1272 'Missing kennel' path is unreachable. Give each a default (= NULL) and keep the NULL check.

The Payments rowset filters only on pmt.UserId = @targetHasherId with no kennelId restriction (line 339). A call for kennel A returns the hasher's payments at kennels B and C too. Possibly intentional (full hasher ledger) but it contradicts the 'scoped to the given kennel' wording in the header (line 23) and lets a kennel-A admin pull another kennel's payment rows for that hasher.
The HasherEventMap rowset (lines 362-410) has no FETCH NEXT clause. When @usePaging=1, Kennels, HasherKennelMap and Hashers are page-limited but HEM is not.

codeSmells.issue: Payments has no ORDER BY and no page limit
codeSmells.detail: The Payments rowset (lines 307-357) has no ORDER BY and no FETCH NEXT. Row order is non-deterministic and the result set is unbounded regardless of @usePaging; a client taking the last row's updatedAt as its watermark can skip rows.

codeSmells.issue: Duplicate event start GMT columns with different derivations
codeSmells.detail: The HasherEventMap rowset returns hemEventStartDatetimeGmt (line 396, CONVERT(DATETIME2, EventStartDatetimeGmt), NULL when the GMT column is NULL) and eventStartDatetimeGmt (line 397, COALESCE(EventStartDatetimeGmt, EventStartDatetime) as DATETIMEOFFSET). Same concept, two shapes; the fallback to raw EventStartDatetime reintroduces the spurious +00:00 offset (see /hc-event-datetimes).
Lines 387 and 391 each run SELECT h.Preferences FROM HC.Hasher per HEM row to compute notes and notesShared. Join HC.Hasher once instead.

codeSmells.issue: authorizedDeviceList and authorizedDeviceCount are always empty/zero
codeSmells.detail: The HasherKennelMap rowset hardcodes '' for authorizedDeviceList and 0 for authorizedDeviceCount (lines 269-270). Placeholders kept for client compatibility.

codeSmells.issue: isMember is a CASE expression returning INT not SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: The isMember column (line 249) is CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, which is INT; the stored HasherKennelMap.IsMember column is SMALLINT. Semantic change vs HC5 too (computed from MembershipExpirationDate rather than stored).

breakingChanges: isMember in HasherKennelMap rowset is now computed dynamically (CASE WHEN MembershipExpirationDate > GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) instead of returning the stored HasherKennelMap.IsMember SMALLINT column. The stored column can be stale; the computed value reflects current membership state. Column type changes from SMALLINT to INT.
@procName parameter widened from NVARCHAR(100) in HC5 to NVARCHAR(128) in HC6, matching OBJECT_NAME() return type.
@includeUnboundPayments SMALLINT = 0 added (2026-09-13) before @procName. Pre-3.1 clients omit it and do not see event-less payments; callers passing parameters by position must account for it.
